title: After a restart, a receipted write-ahead that never reached promotion is settled Ambiguous although its durable row proves it unsent
outcome: After a restart, a receipted write-ahead that never reached promotion is settled Ambiguous although its durable row proves it unsent
acceptance: Decide, with a recorded design ruling, whether restart settlement (src/prompt_delivery.rs, the boot settlement of HandingOff receipts) returns a HandingOff receipt whose durable turn_generation is None to Pending instead of Ambiguous, since promotion commits the turn generation before any send.

If changed, restart_after_the_write_ahead_commit_is_ambiguous_and_never_replayed is revised and a test covers both the never-promoted case (pending, sent once) and the promoted case (ambiguous, never replayed).
